title: Flutter: board widget — grid + hex rendering with CustomPainter
description: BaizeBoard widget renders grid and hex_grid zones. CustomPainter draws cells, cell properties (terrain coloring), component pieces, selection highlights, legal move indicators. Supports square grids (chess, tic-tac-toe) and hex grids (wargame, Hex). Coordinate system matches engine (col,row). Pinch-to-zoom and pan for large boards. Cell tap/drag callbacks for move input.
